    DUNE: PART ONE & TWO (DOUBLE BILL INCL. LUNCH)

    13 December 2026

    Join us on Sunday, 13 December, for a one-off Dune double bill featuring Dune: Part One and Dune: Part Two, with a themed lunch in between included in your ticket.


    After Dune: Part Two, you’ll get to see nine minutes of exclusive footage from Dune: Part Three. It’s the perfect way to prepare for the next chapter in Paul Atreides’ story, arriving in cinemas on 16 December 2026.

     

    Dune: Part One & Two (Double Bill incl. lunch)

    Dune: Part One & Two (Double Bill incl. lunch)

    Regisseur: Denis Villeneuve
    Acteurs: Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Oscar Isaac
    Jaar: 2024
    Speelduur: 375 minuten
    Ondertiteling: Nederlands
